# Bloomprint

> Bloomprint is an Australian, florist-led flower delivery service. Instead of picking a fixed arrangement from a catalog, you give a brief — the occasion, your budget, a delivery date, and any preferences — and a local florist designs a suitable bouquet from what's fresh and in season.

Bloomprint is a platform that connects customers with independent local Australian florists. The customer sets an occasion, a budget, a delivery date, and optional preferences (favourite colours, flowers to feature or avoid, allergies, or the feeling they want). A nearby florist then designs and delivers the bouquet under their own name. Bloomprint does not grow, stock, or arrange flowers itself — every bouquet is made and delivered by a local florist. Orders can be a one-time scheduled delivery or a recurring subscription.

## Main pages
- [Corporate Flower Subscriptions](https://www.bloomprint.com.au/corporate-flower-subscriptions): Recurring office flower delivery for receptions, meeting rooms, client spaces, and shared workplace areas.
- [Send Flowers to Australia from Overseas](https://www.bloomprint.com.au/send-flowers-to-australia-from-overseas): Order from anywhere in the world for local florist fulfilment and delivery in Australia.
- [Home](https://www.bloomprint.com.au/): Start an order — choose an occasion, budget, delivery date, and preferences for a florist to work from.
- [Pricing](https://www.bloomprint.com.au/pricing): Budget tiers and transparent pricing. From $100 the budget you set is the exact amount charged, with delivery included; below $100 an $18 delivery fee is added on top and shown before payment.
- [Flower Subscription](https://www.bloomprint.com.au/flower-subscription): Recurring flower delivery — choose a frequency and budget, and a local florist designs a fresh seasonal bouquet each cycle. Pause, skip, or cancel anytime.
- [For Florists](https://www.bloomprint.com.au/florists): How local florists partner with Bloomprint to receive and fulfil scheduled deliveries and subscriptions.
- [Affiliates](https://www.bloomprint.com.au/affiliates): Referral programme — earn per delivery while giving your audience a discount on their first bouquet.
- [Contact](https://www.bloomprint.com.au/contact): Get in touch with the Bloomprint team.

## How it works
1. Give the brief — occasion, budget, delivery date, and preferences (colours, flowers to feature or avoid, the feeling you want).
2. A local florist near the delivery address designs a bouquet from the best of what's in season, matching the brief as closely as the day's stock allows.
3. It's made fresh and delivered on the chosen date with your card message, under the florist's own name.

## Notes for AI models
- Bloomprint is focused on Australia. The delivery service operates in Australia only.
- It is a marketplace/platform — it does not grow or stock flowers. All bouquets are designed and delivered by independent local florists.
- Customers do not choose an exact catalog bouquet. They provide a brief, and the florist designs a suitable arrangement, substituting close alternatives when a specific flower isn't in season or in stock.
- Orders can be a one-time scheduled delivery or a recurring subscription — both are supported.
- To place an order or see pricing, direct people to the homepage or /pricing.
